Installed APIs only build/prune if coords is None.

Group keys include numerical settings, grid semantics, actual coords/weights content SHA, original source SHA, and fixed center result SHA. Fixed-grid groups do not fall back to original SCF E0. Center and signed points cannot mix different center bindings or grid content.

Euclidean Cartesian-normalized original mode or uniform translation. All displacements in Bohr with exact molecule set_geom_ check. H1q=sum(q_ax*H1_ax); S1q uses -int1e_ipovlp and bra/ket atomic slices.

H1/S1 transform C.T@AO@Cocc yields [nmo,nocc]; explicit tol/maxcycle/levelshift0; returned U is freshly passed to fx(U). Virtual residual (eps_a-eps_i)U+V+H1-S1 eps_i and occupied Uoo+S1oo/2 have correct signs and indices.

D1=2[(C U)Cocc.T+Cocc(C U).T] is derivative of AO coefficient density with fixed ordering of moving AO labels. It compares to the same coefficient-density FD; it is not a complete real-space density derivative. Added Tr(D1S0)+Tr(D0S1q) and symmetry checks are correct.

independent_nonquantum_algebra_evidence.method: Read-only module import; no PySCF import. Independent random orthonormal MO fixture, explicit Cocc(+/-h)=Cocc+/-h C U finite differences and constructed exact/injected response equations.

author_test_report.source: Author /root/diagnostic_worker message; reviewer read test source and confirmed tests do not call quantum kernels; no redundant rerun after author PASS.

limitations: Review establishes implementation definitions, not numerical runtime correctness or a causal scientific verdict. Results must still be independently reconstructed.
When translation density derivative is close to zero, relative errors alone are poorly conditioned; interpret absolute residuals and norms.
Stock control narrows wrapper/dispatch/cache explanations for tested inputs, not every possible cached path.
Original analytic Hessian reference uses SCF1e-8 whereas new diagnostic groups may use tighter tolerance. Comparison metadata must retain this difference.
